claim: The non-concessional and commercial share of Sri Lanka's foreign-currency-denominated debt rose from 12% in 2006 to 59% in 2021.

metric.denominator: foreign-currency-denominated public debt portfolio as classified by the World Bank analysis
metric.basis: World Bank retrospective debt-portfolio analysis using official data
metric.source_definition: non-concessional and commercial component of foreign-currency-denominated debt

bounded_by: Debt composition establishes pre-existing refinancing vulnerability; it does not identify the trigger that made reserves insufficient in April 2022.
notes: Pre-dates both Easter 2019 and Covid shocks.
